title: automate kms/hsm tls rotation + helm/terraform updates for private-installer
author: Sofia Patel
release_notes: Automates TLS/certificate rotation and KMS/HSM key integration for private deployments via new Helm hooks, Terraform module updates, and an upgrade/rollback plan. No public API changes.
description: Motivation: Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) require deterministic, auditable key and certificate rotation for KMS-backed and HSM-backed installations. Manual rotation is error prone and causes extended outages during renewals. This PR implements automated TLS certificate rotation (via cert-manager hooks + sealed-secrets/Vault integration), KMS/HSM key rollover orchestration, and corresponding Helm and Terraform module changes so customers using the private-installer can opt into safe, staged rotations. Summary of changes: 1) Helm: add new charts/templates for rotation job, pre/post-upgrade hooks, and chart values to configure rotation windows, retry/backoff, and key provider (aws-kms, gcp-kms, vault-hsm). 2) Terraform: expose new module outputs/inputs to wire external KMS/HSM resources, add optional lifecycle and null_resource for rotation orchestration, and upgrade module inputs to support key versioning and key aliasing. 3) Installer glue: add a controller and CRD (rotationconfigs) that orchestrates staged rollout across nodes/zone groups, performs KMS-backed signing of new certs, rotates sealed-secrets via Vault transit or KMS envelope encryption, and ensures KV cache and runtime process hot-reload without downtime. 4) HSM: integration tests and runtime codepaths for HSM-backed signing using PKCS#11-compatible gateways; include configuration examples and key provisioning docs. 5) Tests: e2e harness updates for private-installer (local k8s + simulated KMS/HSM), unit tests for new controller logic, and helm/terraform linters. Rollout/rollback strategy: the controller performs a canary rotation against a small node subset, validates healthchecks, then proceeds with parallel waves; failures trigger automatic rollback to previous key/cert version and rotationJobs are idempotent. Migration notes: existing installations must opt into automatic rotation by setting values.autoRotate=true and providing key_provider config; the PR includes a migration script that snapshots current sealed secrets and creates an initial rotationconfig. Security considerations: all rotation operations are logged to audit sinks; private keys never leave KMS/HSM; sealed-secrets are re-encrypted using customer-provided KMS keys or Vault transit keys; RBAC tightened for the rotation controller. Testing and CI: validated via integration-e2e-private-installer, terraform-validate, helm-lint, and security-scan. Backcompat: values default to no-auto-rotate, so installs are safe by default. See linked Linear tickets for rollout timing and customer opt-in plan.
